generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Produce a stable, versioned task contract containing normalized inputs and outputs, objectives, constraints, acceptance criteria and required evidence.

contract.purpose_user_function: Produce a stable task/requirement contract with normalized IO, objectives, constraints, acceptance criteria, and evidence requirements.
contract.valid_inputs: Intent/Requirement IR, selected lane/template, goals/scope, constraints, acceptance criteria, source trace, and optional workflow trigger.
contract.expected_outputs: Versioned requirement/task contract artifacts and bindings to sprint/plan IDs.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes raw intent, requirement IR, product brief/contract and traceability bindings.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Schema failure, missing objective/acceptance, conflicting scope, or unbindable workflow prevents ready contract.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Requirement IR and workflow contracts are shipped; terminology 'task contract' spans several artifact schemas.
contract.success_evidence: Contract validates, preserves raw-input trace, has stable identity/version, and is consumed by planner without hidden fields.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: minimal contract; rich contract; missing objective; invalid acceptance; version/hash; source trace; sprint binding.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§1 and 5; docs/UNIFIED_ORCHESTRATOR_DESIGN.md §2.1 Intent parser
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: build_requirement_ir(), capture(), bind_intent_artifacts(); harness/lib/autosci_intake_contract.py: build_autosci_product_brief()
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Deterministic matching is local; optional model rewriting depends on configured model access. Natural-language completeness and clarification policy remain partly heuristic.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: build_requirement_ir(), capture(), bind_intent_artifacts(); harness/lib/autosci_intake_contract.py: build_autosci_product_brief()
implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
